hero.title: Star City
hero.date: Fri May 29, 2026 — STREAMING NOW (Eps 1 & 2; weekly Fridays through Jul 10)
hero.about: Apple TV+'s first official For All Mankind spin-off, told entirely from the Soviet side — the lives of cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers embedded in Star City, the USSR's space-program nerve center. Rhys Ifans plays the enigmatic Chief Designer, Anna Maxwell Martin a chilling KGB head Lyudmilla, with Agnes O'Casey and Josef Davies in standout supporting turns. Ep 2 'Bear on a Chain': Anastasia Belicova (Alice Englert) becomes the first woman on the Moon but returns home without a hero's welcome. 8 eps total — 2-ep premiere yesterday, then weekly Fridays through Jul 10.
hero.why: Tonight's marquee. Same prestige sci-fi shelf as Foundation and Severance — Apple TV+ doing dense, character-driven alt-history with world-building. Variety calls it 'an intense, immaculate paranoid thriller'; Collider 'a tense, gripping spy thriller.' Mixed notes: some critics say the heavy Cold-War politics and large ensemble take time to land, and it doesn't hit the early-FAM emotional force, but the craft is unimpeachable. Two episodes ready to go tonight — rate it 1-5 stars with 2-3 tags when you're done.

new_this_week.about: Jack Thorne's Netflix adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel — a group of boys stranded on a deserted island, descending from civilization into savagery as the rules unravel. Currently #4 most popular series on Netflix in the US.
